title: 农民工社保缺口：卡住中国消费？，外资高管直言
speaker: Monshen Zhu

segments.en: What happens when this sort of case-shaped economy gets very entrenched? I think you see it in many economies on the world, but it seems like it's more pronounced in China.
segments.zh: 当这种K型经济变得根深蒂固时会发生什么？我认为这在全球许多经济体中都能看到，但在中国似乎更为明显。

segments.en: I don't know if you feel that way, but what happens when you rely on just one sector to really feel growth now?
segments.zh: 我不知道你是否也有同感，但当你现在只依赖一个行业来拉动增长时，会发生什么？

segments.en: I think in the short run, just like the correspondent mentioned, people do expect in the third quarter, there will be some physical and monetary easing on the way, because, for example, in the first half of this year, government bond issuance has been, local government bond issuance has been slowing down, and also that's part of the reason that's why fixed asset investment has been slowing down.
segments.zh: 我认为短期内，正如记者提到的，人们确实预期三季度会有一些财政和货币宽松政策出台，因为例如今年上半年，政府债券发行、地方政府债券发行一直在放缓，这也是固定资产投资放缓的部分原因。

segments.en: But we will see something in Q3 or Q4. If growth continues to beat below expectations. But in the longer period, I see it's more on the income distribution, and also social security net issue, if you try to boost consumer confidence and consumer demand.
segments.zh: 但三季度或四季度我们会看到一些动作，如果增长继续低于预期的话。但长期来看，我认为更重要的是收入分配和社会保障网问题，如果你想提振消费者信心和消费需求。

segments.en: For example, we continue to increase or improve the social safety net. There's still one sort of rural workers that doesn't have enough coverage, for example, house insurance, social securities. Once you increase the social safety net, that people can be able to spend.
segments.zh: 例如，我们继续加强或完善社会保障体系。仍有一类农民工群体保障不足，比如住房保险、社会保障等。一旦加强社会保障网，人们才敢消费。
